claims.evidence: Witness report shows a front suspension fork and knobby tyres, but does not confirm dual (front+rear) shocks, nor clearly confirm wheel size as 26-inch.
Design quality is subjective; witness only reports visible frame branding and general style.
Witness confirms knobby tyres are present, but does not report tread depth, sidewall condition, punctures, or cracks.
Witness confirms dual disc brakes are visible, but does not confirm brake bite/operation or gear shifting performance.
Witness does not show what is adjustable (seatpost, stem, suspension settings, etc.).

risks.risk: Wheel size may not be 26-inch (could be 27.5/29), affecting tyre availability and value.
risks.proof: A clear shot showing the tyre sidewall marking (e.g., “26x…”) or a measurement of rim diameter.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic MTB with unknown wheel size; treat tyres as average condition until sidewall/tread is verified.

risks.risk: Tyre condition may be poor (low tread, dry rot, sidewall cracks, punctures).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tyres: tread depth, sidewall cracks, and any puncture plugs/repairs.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyres needing replacement or at least not guaranteed good.

risks.risk: Brakes may be weak or misaligned (rotor warping, worn pads, hydraulic/mechanical issues).
risks.proof: Video clip of braking: squeeze lever and show rotor/pad contact, plus a close-up of pad thickness and rotor condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes may require service (pads/bleed/adjustment).

risks.risk: Gears/drivetrain may be worn or not indexing correctly (chain stretch, cassette wear, bent derailleur).
risks.proof: Video clip shifting through all gears while pedaling, plus close-ups of chain and cassette/chainrings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as drivetrain may need cleaning/adjustment or parts replacement.

risks.risk: Frame may have hidden damage (cracks, dents, bent fork, misalignment) not visible in the limited angles.
risks.proof: Photos of frame welds and stress points (head tube, bottom bracket, seat tube), fork crown, and a straight-edge/alignment check video.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown condition with potential minor damage; avoid premium.

risks.risk: Suspension may not be functional (stanchion scratches, leaks, seized travel), and seller’s 'dual shock' may be incorrect.
risks.proof: Video clip compressing suspension front and (if present) rear; show rebound and any oil leakage; confirm rear shock hardware if it exists.
risks.if_unproven: Price as front suspension only and/or suspension may need service.

proof_requests: Confirm wheel size with a clear photo of tyre sidewall markings (e.g., 26x...).
Send close-ups of tyre tread and sidewalls (cracks, punctures, repairs).
Provide a short video of braking performance (front and rear) and show brake pad thickness/rotor condition.
Provide a video of gear shifting through all gears while pedaling; include close-ups of chain, cassette, and chainrings.
Send photos of frame stress points and fork crown; include any visible rust/dents/cracks.
Clarify whether it is truly dual-suspension: show rear shock/hinge area and demonstrate suspension travel.
response.reason: The witness report is sufficient to identify the item as a KONG MTB/road-hybrid bicycle with front suspension, knobby tyres, and visible front/rear disc brakes, so it can be priced at a worst-case assumption. However, multiple functional and condition details are not shown, so the price should reflect potential need for service and unknown wheel/tyre/drivetrain health.
